engine.notes: All 15 archive organisations are still live; none confirmed closed. UCB New York reopened a permanent East Village home (242 E. 14th St) in September 2024 after its 2020-2023 closure, confirmed via Wikipedia since ucbcomedy.com itself returns 403 to automated fetches. Asylum NYC and Q.E.D. Astoria are current and active but show no confirmed dedicated improv programming, so they're kept with low s

entries.name: Magnet Theater
entries.summary: Chelsea improv theater and school since 2005, in its own venue with house-team shows most nights and a complete levels-based training curriculum.
entries.schedule: Multiple shows nightly; new Megawatt and Livewire team lineups and a Musical Circuit program launching in 2026
signals: Running since 2005
Home venue at 254 W 29th St
Three shows listed for the night of this check
Internships and show submissions currently open
entries.reasons: A two-decade home venue, nightly house-team shows confirmed live on the day checked, and an actively updated class and team pipeline.

entries.name: The Peoples Improv Theater (The PIT)
entries.summary: Manhattan improv theater and school running since 2002, with nightly sketch, improv and variety shows and a full beginner-to-performance class ladder.
entries.schedule: Shows most nights of the week; confirmed live schedule through October 2-4, 2026 at time of check
signals: Running since 2002
Home venue at 154 W 29th St
Current class calendar and scholarships advertised
Jams, open mics and corporate workshops offered
entries.reasons: A two-decade permanent home, a complete class ladder, and a confirmed current multi-night show calendar.

entries.name: Brooklyn Comedy Collective (BCC)
entries.summary: Brooklyn improv and sketch school across two locations, offering a full class ladder in improv, musical improv, sketch, stand-up and clown plus a packed weekly show calendar.
entries.schedule: Weekly recurring shows including TGIF improv nights, Home Teams and Faculty Lounge; confirmed schedule through October 1
signals: Two Brooklyn locations
Classes across six comedy disciplines
Weekly Home Teams and free community jams
Praised by Time Out New York
entries.reasons: Two active venues, a comprehensive class ladder, and a current, busy weekly show calendar including free jams.

entries.name: The Second City New York
entries.summary: The Second City's Williamsburg, Brooklyn campus, offering a full improv, writing and stand-up curriculum from beginner classes through a conservatory track.
entries.schedule: Classes scheduled into December 2026 with live enrollment counts; weekly drop-ins and free open mics
signals: National Second City training pedigree
Improv levels 1-5 plus a Conservatory track
$35 drop-in classes
Live seat counts show active current enrollment
entries.reasons: A nationally known training pedigree with a full conservatory-track curriculum and confirmed open enrollment running through year-end.

entries.name: Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre (UCB New York)
entries.summary: Legendary improv theater and training center founded in 1999; reopened a permanent home at 242 E. 14th Street in September 2024 after closing its prior NYC venues in 2020.
entries.schedule: Shows and Training Center classes have run from the East 14th Street venue since the September 2024 reopening
signals: Founded 1999
Reopened Sept 2024 at 242 E. 14th St after 2020-2023 closure
Decades of SNL and major comedy alumni
Training Center historically runs beginner through house-team levels
Reopening date not readable on the org site (403 to automated fetches); taken from the UCB Wikipedia article
entries.reasons: Immense longevity and standing with a newly reopened permanent home, marked down because ucbcomedy.com returns 403 to automated checks so its live calendar couldn't be directly confirmed this cycle.

entries.name: Improvolution
entries.summary: Greenwich Village improv school running since 2002, offering intro-through-performance classes for actors alongside corporate and personal-growth workshops.
entries.schedule: Rolling registration for Intro, Launch Into YES and Level 1 class tracks
signals: Founded 2002
Venue at 115 MacDougal St
Intro, 4-session and 10-session class tracks
Site copyright reads 2025, a year behind
entries.reasons: A long-running Village school with a clear beginner class ladder, marked down slightly for a site that reads a year out of date.

entries.name: Face Off Unlimited (FOU)
entries.summary: Astoria improv company running the BATSU! NYC game show and Friday Night Face Off, with its own FOLD program training new improvisers.
entries.schedule: Friday Night Face Off and BATSU! NYC run on a regular cycle; FOLD training on its own schedule
signals: Based at 37-02 Astoria Blvd
FOLD (Face Off Learning & Development) training pipeline
BATSU! NYC and sister BATSU! Chicago shows
Extensive current cast and producer roster
entries.reasons: An established Queens improv company with its own training pipeline and a recognizable recurring show brand.

entries.name: New York Improv Theater (Eight Improv)
entries.summary: Producer of the long-running EIGHT IMPROV flagship show in Times Square, plus corporate, K-12 and event-based improv programming across New York.
entries.schedule: EIGHT IMPROV plays Saturdays at 3pm at the Broadway Comedy Club; school field trips already being booked into January 20
signals: Weekly flagship Times Square show
K-12 educational outreach programs
Corporate workshops for large companies
Blog active through September-October 2026
entries.reasons: A confirmed weekly flagship show and current programming, scored below the dedicated theaters because its model leans toward corporate and event bookings rather than a public class ladder.

entries.name: The Barrow Group Acting School
entries.summary: Manhattan acting school since 1986 offering improv as one of its specialty tracks, plus a recurring TBG Improv Saturdays community show.
entries.schedule: Fall 2026 class registration open; TBG Improv Saturdays recurring
signals: Founded 1986
19,000 sq ft facility with eight studios
Recurring TBG Improv Saturdays show
Alumni include Anne Hathaway and Tony Hale
entries.reasons: A long-established, well-resourced acting school with a genuine improv track and recurring show, scored below dedicated improv theaters since acting training is its core focus.

entries.name: The Armory Comedy
entries.summary: Resident improv company at The Tank in Manhattan running named house teams (Cereal Mascots, No Shots!, Syndicated, Wildcard) and original formats like The Campaign.
entries.schedule: Weekly pay-what-you-can house-team and sketch shows; published calendar last showed dates through June 2026
signals: Resident company at The Tank, 312 W 36th St
Four named house improv teams
Pay-what-you-can pricing
Calendar not updated past June 2026 as of this check
entries.reasons: A real resident company with named house teams and distinctive formats, marked down because its published calendar has not been updated past June 2026.

entries.name: Jersey Creative Lab (JCL)
entries.summary: New Jersey improv and comedy-writing school running level-based workshop series across Hoboken, Jersey City and North Brunswick.
entries.schedule: Fall 2026 sessions include Level 2 Improv (Mondays, Hoboken) and Intro to Improv Comedy (Tuesdays/Sundays, Jersey City a
signals: Level 2 requires 12 prior training hours
Runs sessions in Hoboken, Jersey City and North Brunswick
Active Eventbrite-based registration for Fall 2026
Newsletter signup for future sessions
entries.reasons: A genuine level-based improv curriculum with active current enrollment across the Jersey City/Hoboken area, but no venue of its own and no regular public show calendar.

entries.name: Chicago City Limits
entries.summary: One of New York's oldest improv troupes; its current site shows no public show calendar and reads as a private-booking act for venues and corporate clients today.
entries.schedule: No public show calendar found; shows are booked to venues and organizations on request
signals: Praised historically by the New York Times, Washington Post and New Yorker
Programs for kids, teens, adults and Improv4Business
Most recent dated video content from June 2020
No 2026 public show schedule visible on the site
entries.reasons: Significant historical standing and name recognition, but the current site shows no public show calendar and reads as largely inactive for walk-in audiences today.

entries.name: Brooklyn Improv Training (Letter of Marque Theater Co.)
entries.summary: Letter of Marque Theater Co.'s Brooklyn improv arm, teaching Fundamentals through Level 3 plus free drop-ins, though every upcoming session is listed as TBA.
entries.schedule: Fundamentals 1 (8 weeks, Mondays, $300), Level 2 and Level 3 courses, plus free drop-ins; all next dates marked TBA at t
signals: Full Fundamentals-to-Level-3 curriculum
Free drop-in and advanced drop-in classes
BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ scholarships offered
All upcoming sections currently marked TBA

entries.name: Asylum NYC
entries.summary: 150-seat Manhattan comedy venue with a current show calendar including the Neo-Futurists' Infinite Wrench and stand-up/variety nights; no dedicated improv class track found.

150-seat venue
Hosts the long-running Infinite Wrench
No improv classes or improv-specific shows found on the site

entries.summary: Astoria community events space hosting comedy, storytelling, workshops and screenings; no improv-specific shows or classes were found on its current site.
